name: app-downloader-server
description: Cross-platform application release portal for Cloudflare Pages/Workers and Render

scripts.check: node --check server.js && node --check worker/index.mjs && node --check "functions/api/[[path]].js" && node --check public/script.js && node --check public/admin.js
scripts.deploy:pages: npx wrangler pages deploy public --project-name app-downloader-server
